label: Christoph Benzmüller and Dana Scott, Notes…: Gödel's 1970 axiom Ax4: at every world, if φ is…
locator: GoedelVariantHOML1.thy, Ax4: "⌊P φ ❙∧ (φ ❙⊃⇩N ψ) ❙⊃ P ψ⌋"
interpretation: Axiom Ax4 as stated in the theory, with ❙⊃⇩N its abbreviation PropertyInclusion, φ ❙⊃⇩N ψ ≡ ❙□(❙∀⇧Ey. φ y ❙⊃ ψ y), whose quantifier is actualist, and the free φ, ψ read as universally closed. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Gödel's 1970 manuscript (Benzmüller and Scott), not to what Gödel intended.
